name.id: Metodologi dan Arsitektur Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak

description.en: Research on software engineering methods, processes, and architecture to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability. Topics include microservices design and optimization, clean code principles, software design patterns (MVC, MVVM), and development methodologies such as Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
description.id: Penelitian pada metode, proses, dan arsitektur perangkat lunak untuk meningkatkan efisiensi, kualitas, dan skalabilitas. Topik mencakup desain dan optimalisasi microservices, prinsip clean code, pola desain perangkat lunak (MVC, MVVM), serta metodologi seperti Test-Driven Development (TDD) dan Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

name.id: Aplikasi Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak Berbasis Domain

description.en: Software solutions designed for specific domains and real-world service contexts. Focus areas include educational technology platforms, fintech systems (crowdfunding, digital wallets, P2P lending), healthcare software (EMR, telemedicine), startup and entrepreneurship tools, and industrial automation systems.
description.id: Solusi perangkat lunak yang dirancang untuk domain spesifik dan konteks layanan nyata. Bidang fokus mencakup platform teknologi pendidikan, sistem fintech (crowdfunding, dompet digital, P2P lending), perangkat lunak kesehatan (EMR, telemedicine), alat kewirausahaan dan startup, serta sistem otomasi industri.

name.id: Teknologi Berkembang dalam Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak

description.en: Exploration of emerging technologies to drive and support software innovation. Research topics include automated code quality analysis, bug prediction systems, AI-assisted test case generation, requirements automation tools, code refactoring, form generators, and documentation automation.
description.id: Eksplorasi teknologi baru untuk mendorong dan mendukung inovasi dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak. Topik penelitian mencakup analisis kualitas kode otomatis, sistem prediksi bug, pembuatan test case berbasis AI, alat otomatisasi kebutuhan, refactoring kode, generator form, dan otomatisasi dokumentasi.
